Tamil Festivals 2026 / தமிழ் காலண்டர் 2026

तमिल पंचांग मुख्यतः सौर कैलेंडर है, जिसका उपयोग तमिलनाडु, पुदुचेरी, मलेशिया, सिंगापुर और श्रीलंका के तमिल समुदाय करते हैं। नए साल पुथांडु की शुरुआत चित्तिरई महीने से होती है। नीचे 2026 के तमिल त्योहार दिए गए हैं।

The Tamil calendar (தமிழ் பஞ்சாங்கம்) is a solar calendar used in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Malaysia, Singapore and Sri Lanka. Months begin when the Sun enters a new sign, and the new year, Puthandu, begins with Chithirai. The dates below are the festivals of 2026, worked out for Delhi (IST).

Tamil New Year (Puthandu) / புத்தாண்டு

Puthandu, the Tamil New Year, falls on 14 April 2026, the first day of Chithirai. It is marked with the mango pachadi, a visit to the temple and kolam at the doorstep. Pongal, the harvest festival, is on the first day of Thai.

Popular Tamil festivals

  • Pongal: Thai 1, with Bhogi the day before and Mattu Pongal the day after.
  • Thai Pusam and Panguni Uthiram: star-based festivals of Murugan.
  • Chitra Pournami, Vaikasi Visakam and Aadi Perukku: festivals of the Tamil months.
  • Avani Avittam: the sacred thread change, on different days for Rigveda, Yajurveda and Samaveda.
  • Karthigai Deepam: the festival of lamps, when the Krittika star rules in Karthigai.
  • Soora Samharam and Subrahmanya Sashti: Skanda festivals on the Sashti tithi.

Eclipses and the Smarta/ISKCON split of Rama Navami are shown for 2026 only. For other regional dates, see the Malayalam Festivals, Telugu Festivals and Hindu Calendar.

Tamil Festivals FAQs

When is Pongal in 2026?

Pongal is on 14 January 2026, the first day of Thai. Bhogi is the day before and Mattu Pongal the day after.

When is Tamil New Year (Puthandu) in 2026?

Puthandu falls on 14 April 2026, the first day of Chithirai.

When is Karthigai Deepam in 2026?

Karthigai Deepam is on 24 November 2026.

Is the Tamil calendar solar or lunar?

The month cycle is solar, with each month starting when the Sun enters a new sign. Many festivals combine this with a tithi or a nakshatra.

Dates are for Delhi (IST) and may differ by a day in other cities or traditions. Confirm important festivals with your family pandit.
